# Tien Pham Dinh (Tyler Pham)

> AI Engineer based in Hanoi, Vietnam, with 2+ years of experience building agentic AI systems, computer-vision pipelines, and the MLOps infrastructure that ships them to production. Currently building AI agents for robots at Vin Dynamics.

## About

Tien Pham Dinh (also known as Tyler Pham) is an AI Engineer who turns research into reliable production systems — from multi-agent platforms and RAG systems to face-recognition pipelines and real-time video analytics. He cares less about benchmarks on paper and more about systems that work when real users show up.

- Role: AI Engineer
- Location: Hanoi, Vietnam
- Languages: Vietnamese (native), English, Korean
- Open to: Freelance, consulting, and remote AI engineering work (agents, computer vision, MLOps)

## Skills

- LLMs & Agents: LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, vLLM, LiteLLM, RAG, multi-agent systems, GoClaw
- Computer Vision: YOLO, NVIDIA DeepStream, RetinaFace, ArcFace, CLIP, ONNX, TensorRT
- MLOps & Cloud: GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana
- Data & Backend: Python, FastAPI, Kafka, Spark, PostgreSQL, Milvus, Qdrant, Redis

## Experience

- Vin Dynamics — AI Engineer (Jun 2026 – now): Building AI agent systems for robots — integrating LLMs and multi-agent architectures for autonomous perception, reasoning, and task execution.
- Savvycom Solution JSC — AI Team Lead / AI Engineer (Apr 2025 – Jun 2026)
- 1BitLab Technology — AI Engineer (Sep 2024 – Mar 2025): Built RAG systems with LangChain, Streamlit and FastAPI on GCP; OCR pipelines for document understanding.

## Selected projects

- Savvy Agent: Enterprise assistant on LangChain & LangGraph — policy Q&A via RAG, business reports, timesheet integration.
- eKYC Pipeline: Face verification using RetinaFace detection, MiniFASNet liveness/anti-spoofing, and ArcFace recognition.
- Real-time Video Analytics: NVIDIA DeepStream pipelines over RTSP with YOLO detection and CLIP semantic video search.
- Agent SDLC: Multi-agent system where each agent owns a software-lifecycle role, built on the GoClaw framework.
- LLMOps — Legal QA: Production MLOps on GKE with CI/CD, ELK + Prometheus/Grafana, Terraform IaC, LiteLLM routing, Redis semantic caching.
